svg.text: Native macOS Diablo II — progress
driven by Claude · counts come from code, tests and Ghidra; estimates are marked with ~ · dashed = on branches, not yet verified
updated 2026-10-09
Game v1 complete
weighted average of the bars below (weights in docs/progress.json); dashed = +1% on branches, not yet verified
v1 = double-click the Mac app, make or load a character, play Acts 1-5 single player without a blocker
Game.exe functions named in Ghidra
original 1.14b binary; re-queried live from Ghidra (all 11,257 named; the last 22 Warden and module-loader functions were named 2026-10-09, a few names marked unverified)
Hedged exe names re-verified against the decompile
1,187 confirmed, 71 corrected, ~20 unclear; ~355 left (server/client helpers, library thunks, game-logic rows) (~ estimate of the total)
Original source files indexed
every assert-string path mapped to modules and functions
Source files studied in depth
NPC, units, saves, packets, render, sound, combat, level gen, loot, AI, quests, trade, session, skills, hirelings, lighting
Level generator proven equal to the real game
mazes, Act 1-5 outdoors and presets all match the emulator record for record (427 levels, 30,129 rooms, 0 mismatches), including the seven preset levels and exact maze tiles; landed
Real .d2s save: read and write verified
9 sections read; whole file written back byte-for-byte (golem section unverified)
NPC interaction features
click-walk · greeting · menu · return greeting · vendors · gamble · identify · mercenary hire · quest dialogue ✓ (Act 1)
Acts playable end to end (scripted play)

Acts 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 each pass a scripted real-combat playthrough on the landed tree (2e50f0e4): Act 1 752 s, Act 2 484 s, Act 3 874 s, Act 4 and the start of Act 5 in the full verify, Act 5 caves 574 s
Levels walked by a verify scenario
levels a scenario enters (lower bound, counted from scripts/verify.d); includes the whole Act 3 chain (Travincal, Council, Durance, Mephisto, red portal)
Main quests with logic implemented
all 27 main quests: states, triggers, rewards (Act 1, Radament and nine more driven in scenarios); level quest gates now enforced in the engine (Canyon, tombs, Palace, Durance, Worldstone levels)
Player skills with engine behaviour

141 of 210 player skills have engine behaviour: all 26 missile movement/hit gaps (Meteor, Blizzard, Volcano, Frozen Orb nova, Bone Wall, shouts, Rabies and others) landed with real function bodies; natural mana regeneration landed; Meteor/Blizzard burning ground now hurts players (PvP fractional carry)
Monster AI archetypes implemented
monai.txt entries with a Go think function (about 60 are stand-ins)
Monster AI archetypes ported faithfully
~85: implemented minus about 60 stand-ins (estimate)
In-game UI panels matching the original layout

8 of 14 panels checked in a real game window against the original numbers (150 rectangles, 0 deviating, scenario 9f-ui-layout); 6 panels still unchecked (hireling panel, hirelings list and a few others are on held branches)
Item generation gaps closed vs the exe
11 of the 12 gaps closed and checked against the emulator (stat-list aggregation remains); not wired into every drop path yet
Sound and music confirmed by a human listen
menu music, NPC voices, footsteps, spell/combat sounds, ambient: each needs a person to listen (I can only check logs)
Multiplayer playable through the game screen

menu host/join on the realm, remote heroes move/cast/chat, kills and ears synced; two-window scenario 9j passes through the menus; level changes and the party panel through the realm are not wired (trade works over the legacy path)
Mac app: build, Finder launch with real maps, disk image

+33% done on branches, not yet verified (dashed) · app builds and launches with real maps (verified); release.sh builds, signs ad-hoc and checks app + dmg (BUNDLE OK); the disk image has not been opened by a human; the desktop app was rebuilt from the landed tree
Real full verify green (scenario sections per job, real parallel log)

batch 3 and batch 4 full verify_parallel.sh 6 runs both ALL JOBS PASSED (193 and 194 scenarios; batch 4 with no retry at all); batch 6a: 5 of 6 jobs green, the 6th red only on a scenario that crossed the new level quest gates (fixed in the scenario, passed alone)
Acts played start to finish by a human tester
the real completeness gauge: you play each act in the app and report what breaks (0 so far)
